title: A simple identity
description: Watch multiplication unfold term by term, then simplify.
alt: An animated expansion of the square of a sum, showing four products and then combining the two cross terms.

requirements.description: Show two factors and form all four pairwise products in sequence.
For real scalars, simplify products, make both cross terms match, collect them, and hold the complete final identity.
Produce a looping 960x540 GIF at approximately 15 fps and a valid PNG thumbnail; hold the final result for at least two seconds.
Use LaTeX for all math, Arial-family prose, a white background, stable colors, and unclipped readable expressions.
Include one short paragraph on the beauty of visualization with a relevant 3Blue1Brown hyperlink.
